text:
I could not confirm the answer. Two searches (English and Arabic) found no record of an "Arab Creativity Oscar" from the Arab Creativity Union, and no link between it and any Arab League Secretary General, so my earlier claim that Amr Moussa sponsored it rests on the same unverified snippets. The results returned only the Sharjah Arab Creativity Award, which is a different prize. Amr Moussa (2001–2011) remains a plausible candidate only, and I would not state him as the answer without a primary source.

CONFIDENCE: 25
